title: TimeLitmus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Cross-Modal Understanding and Explanation Faithfulness in Event-Conditioned Time-Series Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.24677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make predictions from numerical time-series histories and textual events. Yet accuracy alone cannot reveal whether correct answers reflect effective integration of the two inputs or instead arise from event polarity, unimodal priors, or superficial cues. Likewise, plausible explanations may rationalize predictions without faithfully reflecting the evidence that drives model behavior. We introduce TimeLitmus, a diagnostic benchmark for cross-modal understanding and explanation faithfulness in event-conditioned time-series prediction. TimeLitmus contains 4,856 evaluation records across Finance and Traffic, combining natural prediction with controlled counterfactual and contrastive interventions, explanation-targeted faithfulness tests, and systematic shortcut controls. translated_title: TimeLitmus：面向事件条件时间序列预测中跨模态理解与解释忠实度的诊断基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于基于数值时间序列历史和文本事件进行预测。然而，仅凭准确率无法揭示正确答案究竟反映了对两种输入的有效整合，还是仅仅源于事件极性、单模态先验或表面线索。同样，看似合理的解释可能只是为预测提供合理化辩护，而未能忠实反映驱动模型行为的真实证据。我们提出了TimeLitmus，一个用于评估事件条件时间序列预测中跨模态理解与解释忠实度的诊断基准。TimeLitmus包含涵盖金融和交通领域的4,856条评估记录，将自然预测与受控的反事实及对比干预、面向解释的忠实度测试以及系统性的捷径控制相结合。在十个代表性LLM上的实验表明，标准预测准确率大大高估了模型可靠的跨模态理解能力。
tldr: 提出TimeLitmus诊断基准，通过反事实干预、解释忠实度测试和捷径控制，揭示标准准确率显著高估了LLM在事件条件时间序列预测中真正的跨模态理解与解释忠实度。
en_tdlr: TimeLitmus is a diagnostic benchmark combining counterfactual interventions, explanation faithfulness tests, and shortcut controls, revealing that standard prediction accuracy substantially overstates LLMs' true cross-modal understanding and explanation faithfulness in event-conditioned time-series prediction.
